The Indian Men’s Hockey Team opened their FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026 campaign with a commanding 3-1 victory over Wales in their Pool D clash. Sanjay opened the scoring with a powerful penalty-corner finish, before skipper Harmanpreet Singh added two goals from set pieces to put India firmly in control. Wales pulled one back late in the fourth quarter, but India’s defence held strong to secure a winning start to their World Cup campaign.
